text:
sophia (Docs): Quick sync: I opened a small PR to clarify the model card for LumenX-4B — specifically the supported quant tags, a compact perf table (512 / 2048), and a short 'If you're on q4_0' migration note. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12789 cc @ryan @mira @noel

ryan (Eng ML): grabbing numbers now. Preliminary: a100x2 fp16 -> 318 tok/s @512, 137 tok/s @2048. t4 q4_1 -> ~93 tok/s @512. Also corrected embed dim -> 2048 (was mistakenly 1024 in earlier card). I'll drop raw CSV in the PR.

mira (Runtime): Heads-up: runtime <1.9 can mis-select kernels for older quant artifacts. Docs should recommend runtime >=1.9 and list supported quant tags: fp16, q4_1, q5. Add a troubleshooting note: run `redwoodctl runtime show-version` and enable `--log-quant-fallback` if you see KV cache errors.

noel (DevEx): I'll add tiny SDK snippets: python streaming generate (max_new_tokens) + embed() with shard_hint. Also a short Node example calling `redwoodctl` to check runtime. Keeping examples short.

isabel (QA): Validated latencies: p50 ~30ms/token (512 fp16), p95 ~75ms. seq=2048 p50 ~65ms. t4 q4_1 p50 ~100ms. Proposing this compact table for the card:
```
seq, hw, quant, throughput(tok/s), p50(ms/tok), p95(ms/tok)
512, a100x2, fp16, 318, 30, 75
2048, a100x2, fp16, 137, 65, 150
512, t4, q4_1, 93, 100, 210
```

sophia (Docs): Perfect. Two editorial asks before merge: 1) explicit bullet list "Quant tags supported: fp16, q4_1, q5" under Compatibility; 2) add migration note titled "If you're using q4_0" — explain why q4_0 may fallback and link to runtime upgrade guide.

ryan (Eng ML): Adding one-line quality note: small measurable drop with int8 on long-form summarization; reference promptset id promptset-2026-11-lumenx. I'll add that under "Notes on quantization."

mira (Runtime): Also call out Private deployments: when CPU-fallback happens, KV rehousing can temporarily increase memory use by ~30% and spike latency. Add an "Operational considerations" bullet.

noel (DevEx): Pushed python snippets and node runtime-check snippet. Used `client.streamGenerate` per SDK v3. Left a comment about tokenization limits.

ci-bot (bot): PR #12789: lint OK, link-check OK, mdx build OK.

sophia (Docs): Merging once the migration note and operational memory figure are in. Will schedule backport for legacy catalog page after merge. Thanks :tada:

isabel (QA): Reviewed the final wording, approved. No safety concerns.

sophia (Docs): (post-merge) PR merged and queued for docs release v1.28. Following up to add a one-line changelog entry.
